_about: PARKED DRAFT (docs/narrative/pending/). Names, alternates and flavour for Combat's twelve rally links (docs/combat/pending/rally/*.md), and a call-out or two for a rally changing hands. Combat's working labels are kept where they were good; one is renamed. Call-outs follow Legal's ln06 style: one line, once, at the moment the rally turns; never over a dazed or bound fighter, never the move's name, never a multiplier or a countdown. Claude-written; unmarked by Orb; unscreened by Legal.

PROTAGONIST.name: Palm Turn
PROTAGONIST.is: overtake: an open palm turns the flying body 90 degrees up or down
PROTAGONIST.flavour: One open palm turns your flight!

PROTAGONIST.name: Net Haul
PROTAGONIST.is: grab in flight: the yank hauls the body to him
PROTAGONIST.flavour: I haul you in, hand over hand!

PROTAGONIST.name: Pillar Lift
PROTAGONIST.is: world link: a send across his pillar throws the body up and away
PROTAGONIST.flavour: Cross my pillar and up you go!

RIVAL.name: Plate Chase
RIVAL.is: chase: sent exactly along the stick's line, no bend
RIVAL.flavour: Straight line. No bend. No escape.

RIVAL.name: Ring Hang
RIVAL.is: grab in flight: the bind holds the body still in the air
RIVAL.flavour: Held in the air. Hold still.

RIVAL.name: Stair Spike
RIVAL.is: spike: three stepped plate impacts straight down
RIVAL.flavour: Three steps down, straight to the ground.

EMPRESS.name: Rope Return
EMPRESS.is: world link: her rope across the flight fires the beam and knocks him back
EMPRESS.flavour: Cross our rope and fly back, rat!

EMPRESS.name: Banner Drop
EMPRESS.is: grab in flight: the banners slam him into the ground from any height
EMPRESS.flavour: Our banners drop you from any height!

EMPRESS.name: Mantle Wall
EMPRESS.is: bank, base form only: the body rebounds off her braced guard
EMPRESS.flavour: Hit our mantle and bounce back, insect!

CYBORG.name: Crane Reel
CYBORG.is: grab in flight: the hook reels the body back and flings it 6 bh
CYBORG.flavour: Reeled in, swung round, flung back!

CYBORG.name: Wreck Toss
CYBORG.is: world link: a wreck hurled at the flying body
CYBORG.flavour: A wreck, thrown at the flying scrap!

CYBORG.name: Slag Catch
CYBORG.is: lob: level-2 slag pops him 3 bh back up
CYBORG.flavour: Slag lands and pops you back up!

PROTAGONIST.alternate: Ha! You turned it on me!

RIVAL.text: Mine now. Try to keep up.

EMPRESS.alternate: Hahaha! The chase belongs to us!
